description: This file declares classes and structures related to EGL window management, including configuration parameters, window creation, and EGL context handling for the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ConfigParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for EGL and OpenGL contexts, including color bits, depth, stencil, and optional features.

classes.name: GLWindowBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for EGL windows, providing interface for initialization, swapping buffers, and error checking.

classes.name: EGLWindow
classes.description: Derived class implementing EGL window creation, display, surface, and context management.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a GLWindowBase or EGLWindow instance.

methods.name: initializeGL
methods.description: Initializes the EGL display, surface, and context.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: destroyGL
methods.description: Destroys the EGL context and surface.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates an EGL context with optional sharing.

methods.name: CheckExtensionExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific EGL extension exists in the extension string.
